name: Ruined architecture kit
brief: Pilaster/base/capital, round/pointed arch segment, broken wall crown, curved eave, snapped timber and half/quarter dome modules. Build exact dimensions and openings procedurally in Blender, with large believable fractures, bevels, solid rear/interior faces, trim/material reuse. Reuse existing Han/lobby/ruin meshes where they already meet the brief.

name: Funerary kit
brief: One body/lid sarcophagus pair and damaged variant; skull with real cavities and a jaw silhouette; bake 3 bone-shelf cluster variants into niche modules. Produce a one-module walking-distance proof before multiplying it. Human/Rodin skull is optional only if that proof fails, using the single-subject H prompt pattern.

name: Interaction and smith kit
brief: Coffer with shaped lid/hinges/feet; regional censer shell; timber ladder overlay; shaped anvil/horn, tongs/hammer, tang-bearing blade blanks, pleated bellows and barrel. Separate operational pieces from anchored decoration; exact proxy/interaction dimensions remain controlled in code.

name: Bells and vessels
brief: Reuse Foundry_Bell and HanCauldron. Derive a cracked horizontal bell from the same construction, add a crown/clapper/suspension frame. Do not commission duplicate simple bells/censers before examining the asset library.

name: Forged chain and restraint kit
brief: One open link, alternating-orientation linked static curves, broken link, socket/anchor plate and post joint. Blender curve-instanced/baked geometry is suitable; no physics chain or per-link update loop. Anchor positions come from authored geometry.

name: Foliage, garden and water kit
brief: Two notched lotus leaves, one closed/open flower, sparse stems, silver-reed/grass clumps and wet-bank transitions. Agents make meshes/cards and code restrained water/ripple/mist/lighting. Do not send entire water surfaces, fog, skies or particle fields to Rodin.

name: Monument and citadel construction
brief: Split cenotaph shaft, basalt terraces, broken aqueduct/arcade, giant modular pier, coped parapet, radial seating fronts, bridge/roof terminations. These are exact geometric construction: an agent with Blender can create them. Hero organic H05 is optional on top, not required for a compelling silhouette.

name: Ritual floor and survey materials
brief: Non-glowing readable inlaid stone rings, damaged star chart panels and low ritual stations outside movement lanes. Use UV/material/normal detail and separate authored emissive effects when required. Avoid bright decals that resemble danger telegraphs.

name: Grounding and damage kit
brief: A few fractured rubble meshes, fractured tile clusters, coarse ash/snow bank profiles, wet edges, sediment/root seams and material blends. Seeded placement must be surface-aware, varied by scale/rotation within believable constraints, and clear of navigation/interaction volumes.

name: Small narrative props
brief: Reuse existing weapons/shields where possible; add spearheads, shield rims/grips, broken statue fragments, carved grave-marker profiles, candles with wick/wax. Low-cost static props; prioritize silhouettes visible at walking distance over dense microscopic ornament.
